explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1202 with the negative answer of Price/GPT-5.4 Pro. It negates: for every ε > 0 there is k such that, for all n, any k primes p_1 < ⋯ < p_k < n^{1-ε} with (p_i - 1)/2 forbidden classes each leave at most εn survivors in [1,n]. The page introduces both ε and η but only uses ε in the bound, apparently a typo. Using ε for both is a special case of the general version, and its negation implies the general negation, so nothing is lost. The construction (survivors ≥ (1/2 - c)n with all primes O(√(n log n)) < n^{1-ε}) refutes it for small ε.
